core_obligations: Set-up (proof lines 1219-1226): the category of abelian presheaves has enough injectives and Cech H-0 is left exact, so the derived functor and its right derived functor exist.

Cech cohomology is a universal delta-functor (proof lines 1228-1248): for an injective presheaf the Cech cohomology vanishes in positive degrees, because the representable complex is exact in positive degrees and the hom functor into an injective is exact; effaceability then makes the Cech delta-functor universal.

Identification with the derived functors (proof lines 1250-1260): the right derived functors of Cech H-0 form a universal delta-functor as well, so by uniqueness the two families agree; the author then remarks that the reader is suggested to skip the rest of the proof.

The quasi-isomorphism (proof lines 1262-1302): resolving the presheaf injectively, the two maps from the Cech complex and from the derived functor into the total complex of the double complex are quasi-isomorphisms, because the columns are exact in positive degrees by exactness of the Cech complex as a functor and the rows are exact in positive degrees by the vanishing just proved.
The author closes by omitting the verification that the morphism is functorial, which is a routine tail of the argument.
proof_roadmap: Use enough injectives and left exactness to have the derived functors.
Show Cech cohomology of injective presheaves vanishes in positive degrees, hence is effaceable and universal.
Compare with the universal delta-functor of right derived functors to identify the two.
Resolve injectively and use the double complex to produce the functorial quasi-isomorphism of the statement.
difficulty_reason: The lemma identifies Cech cohomology with the right derived functors of Cech H-0 on the category of abelian presheaves and produces a functorial quasi-isomorphism between the Cech complex and the derived functor (statement lines 1188-1217). The proof is complete and has three parts: it first verifies that Cech cohomology of an injective presheaf vanishes in positive degrees through the exactness of the representable complex and of hom into an injective, which makes the Cech delta-functor effaceable and hence universal (proof lines 1228-1248); it then identifies it with the universal delta-functor of the right derived functors (proof lines 1250-1258); and finally it resolves the presheaf injectively and compares the two maps into the total complex of the resulting double complex, whose rows and columns are exact in positive degrees, obtaining the quasi-isomorphism of the statement (proof lines 1262-1301). The author marks the middle of the proof as skippable and omits only the functoriality verification at the end; both are retained verbatim inside the counted span.
